long_biography.plain_text:
Ajaykumar Chandulal Gokani built his early business identity in mobile-phone distribution. He became an Elite Mobile director when the company was incorporated in 1994 and later served as chief executive, overseeing handsets, accessories, navigation products and mobile-broadband devices. His fifteen-year board tenure placed him at the centre of a business the British Asian Trust later described him as founding.

Gokani subsequently concentrated on investment, property and hospitality companies. He has held long-running roles at Celtic Trading, Celtic Investments, Goldmoon Properties, Novaplace Properties and Maples Investments. He retained significant control of Celtic Investments through a trust arrangement. He also spent nearly fifteen years on the board of Elgon Hotels. Gokani serves as a trustee-director of the Lohana Charitable Foundation, combining commercial property activity with community work in north London.
